[Open iCode](command:chrys.focusChat)

Chrys starts from `chrys.binary.path`, PATH, or the bundled runtime in a platform VSIX.
configuration.title: iCode
configuration.binary.path.description: Path to a local chrys binary. Leave empty to use chrys from PATH, then the bundled runtime in a platform VSIX.
configuration.agent.default.description: Default agent profile for new VSIX sessions. Empty falls back to CHRYS_DEFAULT_AGENT, then Code.
configuration.model.profile.description: Default model profile ID applied to new VSIX sessions after ACP starts. Empty leaves iCode model resolution unchanged.
configuration.approval.mode.description: Initial approval mode for tool calls.
configuration.approval.mode.manual.descr: Manual approval: approve tools that need permission before they run.
configuration.approval.mode.auto.descrip: Approve for me: let iCode approval judging decide whether a tool can run.
configuration.approval.mode.bypass.descr: Full access: allow tool calls without approval prompts.
configuration.ui.language.description: Display language for the iCode VS Code UI. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
configuration.ui.language.auto.descripti: Follow the VS Code display language.
configuration.ui.theme.description: Display theme for the iCode VS Code UI. Auto follows CHRYS_THEME when it is set to a supported TUI theme, otherwise uses chrys.
configuration.ui.theme.auto.description: Follow CHRYS_THEME when supported; otherwise use chrys.
configuration.ui.theme.chrys.description: Default iCode dark theme tuned to match the TUI composer and sidebar.
configuration.ui.theme.chrys-ansi.descri: iCode dark theme using terminal ANSI-style colors.
configuration.ui.brand.description: Brand mark shown on the welcome page. Click the mark to switch between the iC and C icons.
configuration.ui.brand.icode.description: Use the iCode wordmark and iC icon (default).
configuration.ui.brand.chrys.description: Use the iCode wordmark and C icon.
